owner_instruction: Propose an improvement from concrete diagnosis/cases, implement and execute it; report measured effect honestly
scope: Post-hoc hypothesis motivated by known negative development outcomes and prior source forensics; fresh controlled TRAIN/VALID study, not preregistered discovery or final TEST

teachers.gcn_batching: one full-graph train update per epoch; separate internal-holdout evaluation
teachers.gaga_label_scope: FIT80 only, including during attack training; TUNE20 always masked
teachers.checkpoint_selection: earliest maximum internal macroF1; no original VALID/test labels

attack_training.feedback: Original frozen GCN only in both arms
attack_training.checkpoint_selection: terminal epoch8 only; no VALID measurements during training
unchanged: per-case RNG keys and TRAIN order
attack_training.weight_reuse: Fresh paired initialization per seed; never old-checkpoint inference substitution

requirements: both variants produce finite GCN loss and feature/edge head gradients
same initial parameter content per seed
actual node and nonself undirected edge budgets exact
synthetic known-answer role offset and legacy native parity pass

evaluation.primary: paired source_fixed minus legacy official-GAGA occurrence MR on all frozen128VALID groups; higher stronger attack
secondary: new wrong and recoveries relative clean
all budget/size strata including negative cases
evaluation.interpretation: Development comparison conditional on repeatedly inspected fixed cohort and fixed teacher/victim; correlated target memberships, no IID occurrence interval
evaluation.consistent_development_gain_rule: mean paired delta at least1pp AND positive in all3seeds; report paired t95 with n3/df2 regardless. CI crossing0 remains uncertain. No forced winner.
evaluation.stop_rule: Run this six-job matrix once. No extra seeds, epochs, hyperparameter changes or outcome-selected gates after official GAGA outcomes.

accounting: Two aggregate GPU hours include preflight, six fresh TRAIN jobs, development evaluation and failures; charge maximum outer/guardian lifetime.

companion_saved_graph_diagnostic.scope: 96 previously saved graphs: old4arms x3seeds x8predetermined exportedgroups
companion_saved_graph_diagnostic.purpose: Fresh teacher FIT-view decisions joined to already saved official victim decisions; not used to tune/select source-role correction

failure_rule: Keep immutable unique attempt directories, partial counters and all guardian/outer time. Stop on failure; only explicit construction amendments, no automatic retries or hidden resets.
